findings.body: The retained PR checker launches Autoreview without process-group options (`tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533`) and calls the compatible `started(pid)` signature. This stop path nevertheless calls `killpg(child_pid)` through `src/forge/codex.py:624–625`. That child does not lead a group, so it remains alive and stop refuses without freeing its place. The signature ruling preserves the caller but leaves this launch mismatch unresolved. The existing-queue test migrates a newly grouped process, so it does not exercise the older launch.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: The lane snapshots `chosen` at admission, but Autoreview's reported defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only `selected` (`src/forge/review.py:570–576`). A running review therefore continues showing null or the unavailable model in board JSON. The same stale snapshot occurs when a split design worker switches to Codex (`src/forge/worker.py:167–191`). Update the active entry's model and effort when either caller changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual test launches still bypass this shared entry queue: `src/forge/fasttest.py:165–166` launches directly, while close uses the separate ticket queue at `src/forge/review.py:279–288`. Consequently, board JSON cannot expose their output/progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or stop an item's worker and test together. `plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142` assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
